description: Child account under the given parent account of the store, created through the account API after the parent, optionally with its own Sales Rep. Outputs: accountId, accountName, accountCode, salesRepUserId. Created per test, deleted at teardown before its parent. Story Z10-38546.

store.description: Store code of the parent account (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

parent.description: AccountId of the parent account: link it to the test's parent account (@parent.accountId)

rep.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the child's own Sales Rep (@rep.userId), overriding inheritance. Left out: none set; inherited from the parent if its inheritance flag is Yes
